name: The counting-house job

beats.line: The Party buys plans of the counting-house from those who know its clerks and keys.
After dark the Party slips past the watch and into the counting-house.
A warded door bars the stair down to the strongroom.
The alarm is raised, and the house's guards bar the stair.

finaleLine: At last the strongroom is opened, and the coin is carried out.
